projects.title: 彩云之南
projects.subtitle: 云南 · Yunnan, China
projects.description:
彩云之南，云是会变色的：清晨银灰，正午棉白，日暮时烧成金与玫瑰。从古城的灯火到江水、寺院与雪山，这一页只收下了路上的光。
South of the coloured clouds, where the sky changes its mind all day.

photos.title: 云下
photos.caption:
山把云留住，云又把山藏起来。
Mountains keep the clouds, and the clouds keep the mountains.

日暮，云边镶着光
Dusk, the clouds edged in light

雪峰半掩在云里
A snow peak, half-hidden in cloud

photos.title: 雪线以上，是云住的地方。
photos.caption: Above the snow line is where the clouds live.

雾从松林里慢慢升起
Mist rising slowly through the pines

光从山脊后面落下来
Light falling from behind the ridge

水面上的雾，被阳光梳成一道一道
Mist on the water, combed into rays by the sun

山坡上的村子，梯田一层一层铺开
A hillside village, its terraces laid out in steps

photos.title: 古城
photos.caption:
天一黑，木楼里的灯一盏一盏亮起来。下过雨的石板路，把每一盏灯都映了两遍。
When dusk comes, the wooden lanes light up one window at a time — and the rain-washed stones show every lamp twice.

从天上往下看，路灯把屋顶一块一块缝了起来
From above, the street lights stitch the rooftops together

雨刚停，石板路上还亮着灯
The rain has just stopped; lamplight still on the stones

城楼在雨夜里亮起来
The gate tower, lit on a rainy night

photos.title: 下起雨来，整条街都撑开了伞。
photos.caption: When the rain comes, the whole street opens its umbrellas.

伞面上开着一树花
A tree in blossom on an umbrella

木楼亮灯的时候
When the wooden houses light up

甜茶馆门口，有人坐着歇脚
Outside the tea house, someone resting

灯笼一盏接一盏，挂到巷子尽头
Lantern after lantern, all the way down the lane

photos.title: 线扎紧的地方，蓝色进不去，就留下了白。
photos.caption: Where the thread is tied tight, the indigo cannot reach — and the white is what remains.

灯下的扎染，一块挨着一块
Tie-dyed cloth under the lamps, hung edge to edge

飞檐挑着最后一点天光
The flying eaves hold up the last of the light

彩绘的斗拱，柱子后面是山
Painted brackets; behind the pillar, the mountains

photos.title: 江流
photos.caption:
水从雪山上下来，一路都不肯慢。把快门放慢一点，它就变成了雾。
The water comes down from the snow in a hurry. Slow the shutter, and it turns to mist.

浑黄的江水，撞上黑色的岩壁
Ochre water against black rock

photos.title: 江水撞上岩壁的声音，大得盖过了心跳。
photos.caption: The river against the rock — louder than a heartbeat.

江水长卷
A handscroll of rivers

layers.label: 石头间的流水 · Water between the stones
一块石头，一道白色的水痕 · One stone, one white trail
慢门下，水变成了雾 · At a slow shutter, water turns to mist
青苔与碧水 · Moss and jade water

photos.caption:
从高处看，水是碧色的
From above, the water runs jade-green

photos.title: 香格里拉
photos.caption:
高原的风很干净，经幡把每一句祈愿都吹向更远的地方。
On the plateau the wind is clean, and the prayer flags carry every wish a little further.

湖边的草甸，树刚发了新叶
A lakeside meadow, the trees in new leaf

乌云压着金顶
Storm clouds above the golden roofs

整座寺院，像一座长在山坡上的城
The monastery, like a town grown into the hillside

隔着经幡的颜色
Seen through the colours of the prayer flags

藏式彩绘的墙角，远处屋檐下的灯亮了
A painted Tibetan corner; further off, lamps come on under the eaves

金顶、白塔，和背后的雪山
Gilded roof, a stupa, and the snow range behind

photos.title: 雨落在车窗上，窗外的山被揉成了一幅油画。
photos.caption: Rain on the window, and the mountains outside turn to oil paint.

雨中的车窗
Rain on the window

photos.title: 卡瓦格博
photos.caption:
梅里雪山主峰，海拔六千七百四十米，至今无人登顶。云散开的那几分钟里，整座山被点亮。
The highest peak of the Meili range — 6,740 metres, and never climbed. For the few minutes the clouds part, the whole mountain is lit.

林线之上的一层薄雪
A dusting of snow above the tree line

云开了一道缝，光只落在山顶
A gap in the cloud, and the light lands only on the summit

梅里雪山
The Meili range

photos.title: 等云散开。
photos.caption: Wait for the clouds to part.

日照金山
Sunrise on the golden mountain

金色退去之前
Before the gold fades

整条山脊都烧了起来
The whole ridge catches fire

photos.title: 星河
photos.caption:
夜里的山谷很安静。银河挂在头顶，盘山路上的车灯，是另一条慢慢流动的河。
At night the valley goes quiet. The Milky Way hangs overhead, and the headlights on the switchbacks become a second, slower river.

银河与盘山路
The Milky Way and the switchback road

photos.title: 彩云之南，下次再见。
photos.caption: South of the coloured clouds — until next time.

projects.title: 徽州
projects.subtitle: 安徽呈坎 · 2026
projects.description:
呈坎在黄山市徽州区，是一座按八卦布局的古村。白墙、黑瓦、马头墙，荷塘绕着村子。夏天的夜里，村里人举着鱼灯走过石桥，烟花在头顶炸开。
Chengkan, in the Huizhou district of Huangshan, is an old village laid out to the eight trigrams: white walls, black tiles, stepped gables, lotus ponds all around. On summer nights the villagers carry fish lanterns over the stone bridges while fireworks break overhead.

photos.title: 粉墙
photos.caption:
徽州的房子，墙是白的，瓦是黑的。马头墙一级一级叠上去，原本是为了挡火。
In Huizhou the walls are white and the tiles are black. The stepped “horse-head” gables climb tier by tier — they were built to stop fire spreading.

荷塘边的村子，山在后面
The village by the lotus pond, the hills behind

马头墙，一级一级
Horse-head walls, tier upon tier

墙上的雨痕，和几把晒着的伞
Rain-streaked walls, and a few parasols

石桥和它的倒影，合成一个圆
A stone bridge and its reflection, closing into a circle

木门两边的对联
A couplet either side of a wooden door

白墙上贴满了红色的斗方，过节的样子
Red diamond papers all over a white wall, dressed for the festival

photos.title: 心中若有桃花源，何处不是水云间。
photos.caption: If a Peach Blossom Spring lives in your heart, where is not among water and clouds?

photos.title: 天井
photos.caption:
走进屋里，头顶是一方天井。下雨的时候，四面屋檐的水都流进院子里，叫“四水归堂”。
Inside, a square of sky opens overhead. When it rains, the water from all four roofs runs into the courtyard — “four waters return to the hall”.

抬头，是一方天
Look up: a square of sky

院子里的老松和一池水
An old pine and a pool in the courtyard

井口里，盛着一井的灯
A well holding a whole well of lights

photos.title: 荷塘
photos.caption:
村子被荷塘围着。白天，鱼灯就靠在桥边，等着天黑。
The village is ringed with lotus ponds. By day the fish lanterns rest by the bridges, waiting for dark.

荷叶中间，一条小船慢慢划过
A small boat drifting through the lotus leaves

山脚下的村子和荷塘
The village and its lotus ponds at the foot of the hills

水面上的荷叶
Lotus leaves on still water

满塘的荷叶，后面是白墙
A pond full of lotus, white walls behind

白天的鱼灯，还没点亮
A fish lantern by day, not yet lit

photos.title: 鱼，谐音“余”。年年有余。
photos.caption: Yú, the fish, sounds like yú, plenty: may every year have more than enough.

photos.title: 鱼灯
photos.caption:
天黑了，灯一盏一盏点起来。鼓声里，鱼灯从石桥上游过去，烟花在头顶一朵一朵地开。
Night falls and the lanterns are lit one by one. To the drums, the fish lanterns swim across the stone bridge, and fireworks open overhead.

鱼灯会 · 短片
The fish-lantern festival · a short film

天快黑了，广场上的鱼灯都已经就位
Nearly dark, and the fish lanterns are in place on the square

荷塘里亮起来的鱼灯
Fish lanterns lit up on the lotus pond

鼓点响起，烟花升空
The drums begin, the fireworks go up

人群头顶，烟花开了
Fireworks open above the crowd

船上的鱼灯，水里还有一条
A fish lantern on a boat, and another in the water

石桥上，两条鱼灯迎面相遇
On the stone bridge, two fish lanterns meet

photos.title: 灯灭了，鱼游回了夜里。
photos.caption: The lanterns go out, and the fish swim back into the night.

projects.title: Paris
projects.subtitle: Paris · 巴黎
projects.description:
巴黎是奶油色的石头和锌灰色的屋顶；光从教堂的玫瑰窗里落下来，是蓝色和红色的。这一集从白天的屋顶出发，经过歌剧院、塞纳河和凡尔赛，走到夜里的卢浮宫。
Cream-coloured stone and zinc-grey roofs; light that falls blue and red through the rose windows. From the rooftops by day, through the Opéra, along the Seine and out to Versailles, to the Louvre at night.

photos.title: 从地铁口走上来，巴黎就开始了。
photos.caption: Up the steps from the Métro, and Paris begins.

photos.title: Les Toits
photos.caption:
巴黎的屋顶几乎都是锌皮的，灰蓝色，一片接着一片，中间冒出一排一排的烟囱。
The roofs of Paris are mostly zinc — grey-blue, one after another, with rows of chimney pots in between.

锌灰色的屋顶，一直铺到远处的教堂
Zinc roofs, all the way to the church in the distance

一座哥特式的钟楼，孤零零地立在屋顶之间
A lone Gothic tower among the rooftops

photos.title: 每一根烟囱下面，都是一户人家。
photos.caption: Under every chimney pot, a home.

photos.title: Montmartre
photos.caption:
坡很陡，人很多。山顶的圣心堂是白色的，据说它的石头淋了雨会更白。
A steep hill and a crowd. The basilica at the top is white — its stone is said to grow whiter in the rain.

上山的路，尽头是圣心堂
The way up, and Sacré-Cœur at the end of it

坡上的房子，好像随时要滑下来
A house on the slope, about to slide downhill

photos.title: 坡上的咖啡馆，椅子都朝着街。
photos.caption: On the hill, the café chairs all face the street.

穹顶下的马赛克
The mosaic beneath the dome

烛台一排一排亮着
Rows of candles, lit

光从高窗落下来，落在金色的雕像上
Light from the high windows, falling on a golden statue

photos.title: Bd Haussmann
photos.caption:
百货公司的玻璃穹顶下，人们抬头看的时间，比低头看货架的时间还长。爬上屋顶，整个巴黎都在脚下。
Under the department store’s glass dome, people spend longer looking up than at the shelves. Climb to the roof and all of Paris is at your feet.

老佛爷百货的玻璃穹顶
The glass dome of the Galeries Lafayette

屋顶上看歌剧院，铁塔站在远处
The Opéra from the roof, the tower far off

云很低，铁塔站在天边
Low cloud, and the tower on the horizon

photos.title: Palais Garnier
photos.caption:
加尼叶歌剧院。大楼梯、大休息厅、金色的天花板——加斯东·勒鲁的《歌剧魅影》，就发生在这座楼里。
The Palais Garnier: the Grand Staircase, the Grand Foyer, ceilings of gold. Gaston Leroux set The Phantom of the Opera inside this building.

大楼梯，像一场还没开演的戏
The Grand Staircase, like a play before the curtain rises

photos.title: 灯一亮，金色就从墙上流下来。
photos.caption: When the lights come on, the gold runs down the walls.

大休息厅，天花板从头画到尾
The Grand Foyer, painted from end to end

柱头上的金叶子
Gold leaf on every capital

一盏接一盏的吊灯
Chandelier after chandelier

photos.title: La Seine
photos.caption:
塞纳河把巴黎分成右岸和左岸。秋天的下午，云压得很低，河边的树先黄了。
The Seine divides Paris into the Right Bank and the Left. On an autumn afternoon the cloud hangs low, and the trees along the quays turn first.

秋天的塞纳河，游船往下游开
The Seine in autumn, a tour boat heading downstream

河水绕过西岱岛
The river curving round the Île de la Cité

photos.title: 沿着河走，书摊、桥和路灯，都不着急。
photos.caption: Along the river, the book stalls, the bridges and the lamps are in no hurry.

桥上走着的两个人
Two people crossing the bridge

桥上的路灯，远处是西岱岛的尖顶
Lamps on the bridge, the spires of the island beyond

photos.title: Île de la Cité
photos.caption:
两座教堂，隔着几百米。修复后的圣母院，石头白得发亮；圣礼拜堂的墙，几乎全是玻璃。
Two churches a few hundred metres apart: Notre-Dame, restored, its stone shining white — and Sainte-Chapelle, whose walls are almost all glass.

修复后的圣母院，石头是新的白
Notre-Dame restored — the stone a new white

跪着的雕像，背后是一整面蓝
A kneeling figure against a wall of blue

画满星星的拱顶下
Under a vault painted with stars

photos.title: 在这里，光是有颜色的。
photos.caption: Here, light has a colour.

圣礼拜堂：墙是玻璃做的
Sainte-Chapelle: walls made of glass

烛台、彩窗，和一处还在修缮的窗
Candles, glass, and one window still under repair

每一格玻璃里，都是一个故事
A story in every pane

photos.title: Versailles
photos.caption:
从巴黎坐一趟郊区火车，就到了国王的宫殿：金色、白色，还有画在天花板上的天空。
One suburban train from Paris and you reach the king’s palace: gold, white, and a sky painted on the ceiling.

凡尔赛宫的皇家礼拜堂
The Royal Chapel at Versailles

photos.title: Trocadéro
photos.caption:
傍晚的天是淡紫色的。广场上每个人都在和铁塔合影，有人伸出手，把它轻轻捏在指尖。
The evening sky turns lilac. Everyone on the square is taking a picture with the tower; someone reaches out and pinches it between two fingers.

把铁塔捏在指尖
The tower, between finger and thumb

photos.title: Le Louvre
photos.caption:
天黑以后，玻璃金字塔从里面亮起来，像一盏放在宫殿正中间的灯。
After dark the glass pyramid lights up from inside, like a lamp set down in the middle of a palace.

暮色里的卢浮宫
The Louvre at dusk

从博物馆的窗里看出去
Looking out through a museum window

月亮挂在穹顶上
The moon above the dome

photos.title: 天黑了，金字塔亮了。
photos.caption: Night falls, and the pyramid lights up.

一道光从远处扫过宫殿的屋顶
A beam of light sweeping over the palace roofs

月亮、金字塔，和水里的另一座金字塔
The moon, the pyramid, and another pyramid in the water

拿破仑庭院，正中间的金字塔
The Cour Napoléon, the pyramid at its centre

倒影把金字塔变成了一颗钻石
The reflection turns the pyramid into a diamond

photos.title: 入夜以后，每到整点，铁塔会闪烁五分钟。
photos.caption: After dark, on the hour, the tower glitters for five minutes.

站在铁塔正下方，往上看
Standing right beneath the tower, looking up

photos.title: À bientôt, Paris.
photos.caption: 下次见，巴黎 · Until next time

拍下这些照片的人，在歌剧院的大楼梯上
The one behind the camera, on the Opéra’s Grand Staircase

projects.title: 皇城根ber地道
projects.subtitle: Beijing
projects.description:
皇城根儿底下：红墙金瓦的紫禁城，一条将近八公里的中轴线，胡同里的灰瓦，冬天的冰糖葫芦，还有夜里亮着灯的国贸。
At the foot of the imperial city: the red walls and golden tiles of the Forbidden City, a central axis nearly eight kilometres long, grey hutong roofs, candied hawthorns in winter, and the business district lit up at night.

photos.title: 紫禁
photos.caption:
紫禁城建成六百多年了。红墙、金瓦，宫门上横九路、竖九路的门钉。
The Forbidden City has stood for more than six hundred years: red walls, golden tiles, and nine rows of nine gilded studs on its gates.

倒过来看，水里的角楼才是真的
Turned upside down: the corner tower in the moat is the real one

红墙之上，琉璃瓦和彩画
Glazed tiles and painted beams above a red wall

屋脊上的脊兽，一个跟着一个
Ridge beasts, one after another along the eave

photos.title: 墙很高，天很蓝，时间走得很慢。
photos.caption: The walls are high, the sky is blue, and time moves slowly.

石栏的缝隙里，一角金顶
A golden roof through a gap in the stone balustrade

汉白玉栏杆后面的山墙
A painted gable behind the white marble balustrade

阴影里的琉璃瓦和脊兽
Glazed tiles and a roof beast, in shadow

暗处的斗拱
Bracket sets in the dark

枝条后面的红柱子
A red pillar behind the branches

photos.title: 雪
photos.caption:
下雪的时候，紫禁城只剩下红、白、灰三种颜色，整座城都安静了。
When it snows, the Forbidden City is left with three colours — red, white and grey — and the whole city goes quiet.

从景山往南看，雪里的紫禁城
The Forbidden City in snow, looking south from Jingshan

雪里的角楼
The corner tower in snow

雪天里的中国结
A red knot on a snowy day

石兽，角楼，一场雪
A stone beast, the corner tower, a fall of snow

photos.title: 中轴
photos.caption:
北京有一条中轴线，从永定门一直到钟鼓楼，七点八公里。站在高处往南看，整座城沿着它对称地铺开。
Beijing is built along a central axis, 7.8 kilometres from Yongdingmen to the Bell and Drum Towers. Look south from up high and the city lays itself out symmetrically along it.

顺着中轴线往南看
Looking south along the central axis

鼓楼，隔着一层冬天的雾
The Drum Tower, behind a veil of winter haze

楼里很暗，门外是另一座楼
Dark inside; through the doorway, another tower

景山上的亭子，天快黑了
A pavilion on Jingshan, as night comes on

汉白玉栏杆和飞檐
Marble balustrades and flying eaves

飞檐，和最后一点天光
Upturned eaves and the last of the light

胡同的灰瓦，远处是国贸的楼
Grey hutong roofs, and the towers of the business district beyond

photos.title: 灰瓦底下，是一户一户的四合院。
photos.caption: Under the grey tiles, courtyard after courtyard.

冰糖葫芦，北京冬天的颜色
Candied hawthorns — the colour of a Beijing winter

photos.title: 白塔
photos.caption:
北海的白塔，从老城很多地方都能远远看见。
Beihai’s White Dagoba can be seen from far across the old city.

花枝后面，远远的白塔
The White Dagoba, far beyond the blossom

白塔上的眼光门
The niche on the face of the White Dagoba

白塔，和它脚下的殿顶
The White Dagoba above a temple roof

photos.title: 颐和
photos.caption:
冬天的昆明湖结了冰。太阳落向西山的时候，金光从十七孔桥的桥洞里一个一个穿过去。
In winter Kunming Lake freezes. As the sun sets toward the Western Hills, golden light passes through the Seventeen-Arch Bridge, arch by arch.

金光穿过十七孔桥
Golden light through the Seventeen-Arch Bridge

柳枝，夕阳，冰面
Willow, sunset, ice

太阳落到西山后面
The sun going down behind the Western Hills

落日，西山，冰面
Sunset, the Western Hills, the ice

photos.title: 夜
photos.caption:
从老城往东看，是另一个北京。中国尊亮起来的时候，胡同里的灯也亮了。
Look east from the old city and there is another Beijing. When China Zun lights up, so do the lamps in the hutongs.

湖边的灯，一条船
Lights along the lake, and one boat

夜里的湖岸
The lakeshore at night

柳树下的灯
Lights beneath the willows

天黑之前的国贸
The business district, just before dark

蓝调时分的国贸
The business district at blue hour

胡同口，银河SOHO亮着
Galaxy SOHO glowing over a hutong lane

曲线，一层叠着一层
Curves, floor upon floor

写字楼的灯，一格一格亮着
Office towers lit, window by window

photos.title: 皇城根儿底下，老北京和新北京，只隔着一条街。
photos.caption: At the foot of the imperial walls, old Beijing and new are one street apart.

projects.title: 新疆
projects.subtitle: China2023
projects.description:
从雪山公路一路向下，经过白沙与碧水，走进开满杏花的山谷。
Down from the snow road, past white sand and blue water, into a valley of apricot blossom.

photos.title: 路
photos.caption:
路沿着山走，山上落着新雪。风很大，云压得很低，一道铁丝网、一排电线杆，就是全部的人迹。
The road follows the mountains, fresh snow on their flanks. The wind is strong and the cloud hangs low; a wire fence and a line of poles are all there is of people.

铁丝网后的雪山，碎石一直铺到山脚
Snow mountains behind the wire, gravel all the way to their feet

护栏外是一整片碧蓝，风暴正从山后压过来
Beyond the guardrail, all turquoise; a storm leaning over the ridge

photos.title: 白沙
photos.caption:
沙是白的，山也是白的，分不清哪一片是雪。只有湖水是另一种颜色。
The sand is white and so are the mountains; it is hard to tell which part is snow. Only the lake is another colour.

白色的沙山，蓝色的湖，灰色的天
White sand hills, a blue lake, a grey sky

风把沙吹成一道道波纹，一直推到水边
The wind combs the sand into ripples, right down to the water

photos.title: 碧水
photos.caption:
云影走过的时候，湖水从碧绿变成深蓝。赭色的山不动，水一直在变。
When a cloud's shadow passes, the water turns from turquoise to deep blue. The ochre mountains stay still; the water keeps changing.

赭色的山把一湖深蓝抱在中间
Ochre mountains holding a lake of deep blue

从高处看，湖水绕过一道道沙岸
From above, the water winds around spits of sand

photos.title: 红柳
photos.caption:
雪山下最先醒来的颜色，是红柳的枝条。叶子还没有长出来，枝条已经红透了。
Beneath the snow range, the first colour to wake is the red of the willow stems — bare of leaves, already red all through.

红柳一丛丛立在雪山前
Red willow standing in clumps before the snow range

photos.title: 雪线以下，春天来得很慢
photos.caption: Below the snow line, spring comes slowly

photos.title: 杏花
photos.caption:
山谷里，杏花开了。羊在树下吃草，人从花下走过，岩壁一动不动。
In the valley the apricots are in bloom. Sheep graze beneath them, people walk under the flowers, and the cliffs do not move.

一树杏花下，羊低头吃草
Under an apricot tree in bloom, the sheep keep grazing

岩壁下的几间小屋，杏花开在门前
A few small houses under the cliff, blossom at the door

河滩上的石头，岩壁下的花，两个人走过
Stones on the riverbed, blossom under the cliff, two people walking past

山在雾里，杏花开在山脚
Mountains in the haze, apricots blooming at their feet

projects.title: Fujisan
projects.subtitle: Japan · 2025
projects.description:
从湖对岸的富士山，到京都的鸟居、庭园与灯火。
From Mount Fuji across the lake to the torii, gardens and lanterns of Kyoto.

photos.title: 富士
photos.caption:
山顶停着一朵云，像刚刚升起的烟。湖面很静，水鸟游过，留下一道光。
A single cloud rests on the summit like smoke just risen. The lake is still; a pair of water birds leaves a line of light behind.

云从山顶散开，湖上横着一座桥
Clouds drifting off the summit, a bridge laid across the lake

山顶一朵云，湖面一道光
A cloud on the summit, a line of light on the water

photos.title: 湖畔
photos.caption:
天黑下来，湖边的灯一盏一盏亮了，山只剩下一道轮廓。
As the dark comes down, the lamps by the lake come on one by one; the mountain is only an outline now.

湖边的灯亮了，山退成一道影子
The lakeside lamps come on; the mountain recedes into a silhouette

photos.title: 鸟居
photos.caption:
一道道朱红的门，一层层往山里去。阳光从杉树间漏下来，落在朱红上。
Vermilion gates, one after another, leading up into the hill; sunlight slips between the cedars and lands on the red.

杉林里的鸟居，阳光照在朱红上
Torii among the cedars, sunlight on vermilion

抬头看，鸟居一座接一座
Looking up: one torii after another

朱红的门，框住了整座城
A vermilion gateway framing the whole city

photos.title: 庭
photos.caption:
青苔、石灯笼、一池倒影。窗外的绿落在漆黑的桌面上，又长出一座庭园。
Moss, a stone lantern, a pool of reflections. The green outside the window falls on a black lacquered table and grows a second garden.

青苔、石灯笼和一池倒影
Moss, a stone lantern, a pool of reflections

窗外的绿，落在漆黑的桌面上
The green outside, fallen onto a black lacquered table

photos.title: 灯
photos.caption:
夜里，一排灯笼写着「不动明王」。香烟慢慢升起，有人在灯下停了一会儿。
At night a row of lanterns reads “Fudō Myōō”. Incense smoke rises slowly; someone pauses beneath the light.

灯笼上写着「不动明王」，香烟慢慢升起
Lanterns inscribed “Fudō Myōō”, incense rising slowly

取景器里，又是一座富士山 —— 按下快门的人
In the viewfinder, another Mount Fuji — the one behind the camera

projects.title: Deep in the Alps
projects.subtitle: Switzerland 2026
projects.description:
从开花的小镇出发，走进雪山下的山谷，一直待到满天星斗。
From a town in blossom up into the valleys below the snow, staying until the sky fills with stars.

photos.title: 春
photos.caption:
山下已经开花了，山上还是雪。
Down in the town the trees are in blossom; up on the mountains it is still snow.

粉色的花开在老房子前
Pink blossom in front of an old house

photos.title: 山谷
photos.caption:
小路沿着山坡往下，木屋散在草地上，对面是一整面雪山和悬崖。
A path runs down the slope, wooden chalets scattered over the meadow; across the valley, a whole wall of snow and cliff.

小路、木屋和对面的雪山
A path, the chalets, and the snow mountains across the valley

雪山和峡谷，一整面山墙
Snow peaks and the gorge, one long wall of mountain

枯草里的一道小溪，远处是雪山
A trickle of water through dry grass, snow peaks beyond

photos.title: 山光
photos.caption:
太阳落下以后，最后一点光留在山顶；然后，山谷里的灯亮了起来。
After sunset the last light stays on the summits; then the lights come on down in the valley.

同一座山，从日落到入夜
The same mountains, from sunset to nightfall

photos.title: 星
photos.caption:
夜里，木屋只剩一扇亮着的窗，天上全是星。
At night a chalet is one lit window, and the sky is all stars.

星空下，木屋亮着灯
Under the stars, a chalet with its lights on

星星落满山谷，灯光沿着谷底流
Stars over the valley, lights running along its floor

photos.title: 灯火
photos.caption:
峡谷里的村子亮着灯，瀑布从崖上落下；另一条山谷里，马特洪峰立在夜色中。
In the gorge a village is lit, a waterfall dropping from the cliff; in another valley, the Matterhorn stands in the night.

峡谷里的村子、教堂和瀑布
A village in the gorge: the church, the waterfall

马特洪峰下，小镇的灯火
Beneath the Matterhorn, the lights of the town

projects.title: Yunnan
projects.subtitle: Southwest China
projects.description: There are places you remember as a colour. Here, it is the blue of a river, the amber of a rain-lit lane, the gold that briefly finds a mountain. These photographs follow those small changes: from the forest floor to the roofs of the high country, and on into the night.

photos.title:
Where the
water slows.
photos.caption: The forest lets the mist pass through. Water gathers the colour of the trees, then carries it away. The first part of the journey follows its quieter paths.
The forest appears, disappears, appears again.
Autumn holds its reflection in the shallows.
Bare branches, doubled by the stillness.
New leaves at the foot of a dark forest.
The meadow belongs to the horses for a while.
Light rests on the lake before it reaches the shore.
A road passes through the green folds of the hills.
The fields follow the patient curves of the land.
The forest gives way to a small, stony clearing.
A small atlas of stones and running water.

photos.title:
The river keeps moving.
The photograph asks it to stay.
photos.caption: A slower shutter leaves the stones where they are, and lets everything else pass.
Ochre water meets the dark wall of the gorge.
For all its weight, the rock cannot hold the river.
Five ways of watching water.

layers.label: The current draws a blue line through the forest.
A hundred small currents, finding one way through.
Water loosens its grip on the stones.
One stone divides the water into two silken paths.
Beneath the moving surface, the stones remain.

photos.caption: White water writes along the shore.
The river leaves a white fringe on the stones.
From here, the current is a pattern of turquoise and white.

photos.title:
When the
lamps come on.
photos.caption: Blue settles over the roofs. Below it, the lanes collect a warmer light: a doorway, a paper umbrella, a lantern reflected in rain. The town is read one window at a time.
From above, the streets become threads of light.
Rain polishes the last blue hour into the stones.
The tower keeps the last of the evening.
A little shelter, lit from within.
Lantern after lantern, the lane draws you in.
Cloth and calligraphy, warm beneath the lamps.

photos.title:
The evening is stitched
in blue and amber.
photos.caption: Blue in the cloth, gold in the windows. The old lanes hold both.
Above the doorway, another evening gathers.
At the threshold, the light is almost enough to touch.

photos.title:
A quieter
kind of gold.
photos.caption: Up here, gold belongs to the roofs as much as to the sun. Painted beams hold the darkness beneath the eaves; the mountains keep their distance. Look slowly. There is more than one way to be still.
A gold roof, held between two walls.
Painted timber, a red pillar, the mountain beyond.
A roofline against a sky still deciding on rain.
Gold above the rooftops. Weather above everything.
A monastery glimpsed through a blur of colour.
The hillside gathers around the golden roofs.
A brief clearing in the weather.
A painted corner under the weight of the weather.
The eaves lift into the falling blue.

photos.title:
Learning
to wait.
photos.caption: For a long time, there is only cloud. Then a ridge appears, a patch of snow brightens, and the scale of the landscape changes. The light stays briefly. The looking takes longer.
Before the day has found its colours.
Above the trees, the last snow lingers.
Cloud shadows move across the high country.
The mountain, close enough to fill the frame.
Snow, cloud and the long line between.
The ridge catches the light before the valley does.
The same mountain, a little more sky.
Between two clouds, a little room for the light.
Rain on the window; the world becomes a watercolour.

photos.title:
To see a mountain,
first learn to wait.
photos.caption: The cloud is part of the view.
A window in the clouds, open for a moment.
For a moment, the clouds leave a seam of gold.
Before the gold gives way to blue.
A whole horizon, touched with gold.

photos.title:
The other
river.
photos.caption: The road keeps a thin thread of light. Far above it, the stars make another crossing. After all the noise of water, the journey comes to rest beneath a larger silence.
Headlights trace the valley beneath a river of stars.

photos.title:
A river in the valley.
Another in the sky.
photos.caption: And for a little while, a place to stand between them.
